facts.label: Imperativo, first e then
facts.sub: Dê instruções com o verbo base: First, make a big ball. Then make a smaller ball. Use Now e please. Pergunte What’s next? para pedir o passo seguinte.

facts.label: Imperativo
facts.sub: Para dar instruções, use o verbo na forma base, sem sujeito: Make a big ball. Put it on top. Look in the kitchen. É a forma mais simples e muito usada.

facts.label: Primeiro
facts.sub: Para começar uma sequência, use First: First, make a big ball with the snow. A vírgula depois de First ajuda a leitura. Use o verbo na forma base logo depois.

pages.title: A quiet yard · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Sunday morning in a quiet yard in Edinburgh. Fresh snow covers the grass. Paulo comes out with warm gloves. His friend Alma waits near the fence. They want to build something fun. Alma gives the first idea.
“Hi, Paulo! Let’s build a snowman in the yard.” says Alma. “Great idea! What do we do first?” says Paulo. “First, make a big ball with the snow. Roll it on the ground.” says Alma.
